title: Pottery Classes NYC

services.name: Pottery Guides
services.desc: A special edition set of four slab-building templates, each drawn from a vessel Matisse kept in his studio and painted again and again. Fiera and Margarita are jugs, Balaustre is a baluster urn, and Amélie is a two-handled glass vase. All four are built by hand, no wheel. - Full-scale templates for all four vessels: Amélie, Balaustre, Fiera, and Margarita A printed assembly sheet for each vessel, with specs and build sequence - Digital: Instant PDF download for all 4 templates. Print on Letter or A4, reuse as many times as you like. - Physical: Printed booklets for all 4 templates, shipped from Brooklyn in 3-5 business days. Shipping takes 7-21 business days. I don't offer tracking to keep

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: A pottery template is a printable paper pattern you trace onto a clay slab to build consistent mugs, vases, cups, and vessels - no wheel.
